name: Cannabis Bioscience International Holdings, Inc.
summary: China Infrastructure Construction Corp. delivers specialized education focusing on medical cannabis to audiences in the United States and Latin America, while also reaching a global market through its online programs. The company further extends its services to therapeutic areas, including supporting clinical trials and offering focused treatment for sleep disorders, specifically those linked to infertility, all managed through its fertility and sleep center located in Houston, Texas. Its Pharmacology University division broadens this scope by providing consulting, digital publishing, marketing, and franchising opportunities, alongside additional educational content related to medical cannabis. Founded in 2003, the organization's main operational hub is situated in Houston, Texas.
